description: Add a portal menu entry. Top-level: module_ai_id + module_id. A submenu group: module_ai_id='submenu' + name (no module_id). An entry inside it: parent_section_id + module_ai_id + module_id. module_ai_id kinds: form_ID/table_ID = a form, report_ID = a report, map_ID = a map, cal_ID = a calendar, chart_ID = a chart. The portal's dashboard is not an entry you add: a portal whose home is a page shows the dashboard's cards on that home page (its first entry); otherwise the menu shows «Dashboard» by itself. A URL entry never points at the project's own address (/apps/<project>): people of the portal cannot open it.

module_ai_id.description: form_ID, table_ID, report_ID, map_ID, cal_ID, chart_ID, 'submenu' for a submenu group, or 'quintachat' for the project's inbox (QuintaChat: clients write to the business's Telegram bot or WhatsApp number, the team answers) — no module_id for it, one entry a portal

module_id.description: The real ID of the module (a form, report, map and so on). Not needed for a submenu group.

parent_section_id.description: ID of the parent submenu section (from list_portal_menu_items) — for sub-items

name: add_portal_menu_item
